# Finding Value in the U.S. Growth Sector

Report 139 | Published 2024-06-22 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2024-6-22/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/139.json)

Growth valuation, frontier money, and crypto policy.

Booking business growth supported the GARP premise while Elevance growth disappointed materially. Egypt analysis identified vulnerabilities but later financing resilience prevents an all-purpose crisis win. The staking-enforcement timing was correct; securities-law merits were not adjudicated.

**Coverage:** Read all source blocks and charts, including Egypt, four equities, China, fiscal/liquidity forecasts and securities-regulation discussion. Personal anecdotes and portfolio listings without theses excluded.

## Claims

### 139-C01

**QT ends 2025**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Mixed |
| Type | forecast |
| Horizon | 2025 |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | fed-balance-sheet-2025-pivot |
| Source blocks | 9 |
| Thesis family | fed-balance-sheet-2025-pivot |

The Fed operational turn occurred in December. That resolves QT/purchases timing, but not whether the exact net-liquidity chart exceeded its prior range.

**Direction:** Separable components differ.

**Timing:** 2025

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Next test:** Reconstruct Fed assets less Treasury cash and reverse repos at the stated range boundaries.

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Reserve management purchases](https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/opolicy/operating_policy_251210a) | Federal Reserve Bank of New York | 2025-12-10 | Verified in the audit

The Desk announced $40 billion of initial bill purchases starting December 12, to maintain ample reserves. This is not itself evidence of deficit monetization as the causal motive.
